observed_copy.original_description: A minimalist oil-based skincare booster made with original Volufiline raw material from Sederma, France. Designed to be mixed with cream, lotion or serum for targeted firmness and fuller-looking skin care.
observed_copy.original_ingredient_text: Ingredients Minimalist Oil-Based Formula Original Volufiline™ raw material from Sederma, France in a concentrated oil-based format. For the complete and most current ingredient declaration, refer to the INCI list printed on the product packaging. Texture: Oil-type concentrate. For comfortable application and spreadability, mixing 1–2 drops with cream, lotion or compatible serum is recommended. Caution: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Patch test before first use. Discontinue use if persistent irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

acceptedAnswer.text: Volufiline is a cosmetic ingredient developed by Sederma, France. CELDYQUÉ uses the original Volufiline raw material in an oil-based concentrated booster designed for targeted firmness and fuller-looking skin care.

CELDYQUÉ Volufiline 100% refers to using the original Volufiline raw material as the concentrated formula rather than diluting it into a conventional water-based serum base. It does not mean 100% pure sarsasapogenin.

original_faq.name: How do I use CELDYQUÉ Volufiline 100% Concentrate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 1–2 drops of CELDYQUÉ Volufiline 100% Concentrate to your usual cream, lotion or serum, mix in your palm, and apply to areas where you want focused firmness care.

original_faq.name: Can I mix Volufiline with moisturizer or serum?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. CELDYQUÉ Volufiline 100% Concentrate is specifically suited to customized mixing. Add 1–2 drops to your usual moisturizer, cream or compatible serum before application.
The original Volufiline raw material used by CELDYQUÉ is supplied by Sederma, France. CELDYQUÉ then uses this ingredient to create the finished cosmetic product.
